items.question: What worldly rewards accompany one associated with this hymn?
premises: Very abundant wealth is attributed as a reward.
Long life is attributed as a reward.
Possession of sons and fame is attributed as a reward.
items.inference: The hymn is associated with the attainment of abundant wealth, longevity, offspring, and fame.
uncertainties: Whether these rewards apply to the composer, reciter, or devotee is not explicitly specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: One gains very abundant wealth, long life, sons, and fame.
